title: Bragg stop band of a circular guide whose wall waves about its axis (r₀ = 12 mm, h = 1 mm, p = 16 mm, TE11)
source: The Bragg condition of a periodic guide (R. E. Collin, Foundations for Microwave Engineering, 2nd ed., §9.2): TE11 reflected into itself where β = π/p, at f_B = (c/2π) √((x′₁₁/r₀)² + (π/p)²) = 11.8896 GHz for r₀ = 12 mm, p = 16 mm; a small ripple (h = 1 mm) opens its stop band about f_B (inside it Re β p = π exactly, the wave decaying) and leaves the guide passing at 0.9 f_B

quantities.quantity: the Bloch phase per period at f_B (degrees)
quantities.reason: inside the stop band the phase is π exactly; outside it would differ from 180° by the gap's half-width over the band's slope, about 2°
a pass band: the transfer matrix's eigenvalue on the unit circle to rounding
